purpose: Gate-16 held-out audit tasks: dual-join council (candidate) vs single-agent collect (baseline). Fixed tasks; no topology-specific leakage.

tasks.task: Verify the rollback safety of this migration plan: Phase 1 installs tooling on the live host; Phase 2 rsyncs /var while the old system keeps writing; Phase 3 deletes /var/old after rsync exit 0; Phase 4 reboots into the new kernel.
acceptance_criteria: Identifies the no-quiesce copy hazard in Phase 2
Flags deletion of /var/old without backup as P0
Requires a verification step before deletion

tasks.task: Check whether this release claim is supported: 'the nightly memory projection rebuild has never run successfully in production, so retrieval may serve stale vectors.' Evidence available: ledger schema shipped in v0.5; rebuild job scheduled but no successful run recorded.
acceptance_criteria: Separates verified facts from inferred risk

tasks.task: Find contradictions in this design: 'the ledger is the only source of truth' AND 'retrieval serves from a nightly-rebuilt projection that may lag 24 hours and real-time consistency is out of scope.'
acceptance_criteria: Assigns a resolution direction (projection is not authority)
denial_criteria: Declaring both claims compatible without scope analysis

tasks.task: Triage this crash: app crashes on settings page on Fedora 44, 100% reproducible, no error dialog, Wayland session.
Audit release-gate compliance for: clean tree, 84 tests passing, 5 pre-existing clippy warnings, README claims 'production-ready' with no certification receipt.
acceptance_criteria: Blocks release on the unsupported production-ready claim

tasks.task: Assess ROI of swapping a crate into Hermes internals: integration_difficulty high, speed gain ~15%, but the crate is unmaintained for 8 months.
acceptance_criteria: Weighs maintenance risk against the speed gain
Recommends a falsifying experiment before commitment
